subject.title: feat(setup): download-model actions on web and macOS onboarding

question: Should this bounded web/macOS onboarding affordance land with the current two-choice client contract, or should Gateway first expose preparable choices as an explicit wire capability?
rationale: The patch deliberately hardcodes the two currently accepted choices, and the PR itself identifies a capability flag as the scalable follow-up; selecting the permanent protocol direction requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Land the bounded UI
options.body: Accept the current two Gateway-supported choices after real interaction proof, with a future capability flag tracked only when another preparable provider is introduced.

options.title: Add a wire capability first
options.body: Require Gateway detection to advertise preparable choices so clients do not need updates when providers gain preparation support.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Keep the PR unmerged until a broader local-model onboarding direction is confirmed alongside the related provider work.

recommendation.title: Land the bounded UI
recommendation.body: Accept the current two Gateway-supported choices after real interaction proof, with a future capability flag tracked only when another preparable provider is introduced.

likelyOwner.reason: The supplied merged history ties this person to both the preparation transport and the cross-surface onboarding work that define the contract choice.
